effects.text: +1 to a stat of your choice for 2 turns.

description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

1 Action (1 scrap): Gain +1 to a stat of your choice for 2 turns.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): Lasts 1 minute; you are Stunned for 1 turn after the effect ends.

Passive: Temp HP you receive increases by 1.

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Elixir B (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Elixir B" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.

[M] Apply the +1 stat bonus for 2 turns.
